methodology.goal: Exhaustive named character/entity discovery and gap audit without modifying data/characters.json.
laws: No same-name identity merge without explicit source evidence.
Named fictional or constructed entities are auditable even when not Arthitean species, because Arthratan mythology scope includes entities related to Arthiteans.
Real-world/source-person references do not automatically become public fictional-character pages.
Hypothetical/example names are not promoted to persistent identities unless the source establishes them as such.
Missing facts remain gaps rather than being inferred.

entries.name: Lyraen
entries.evidence: Introduced as a high-ranking Kafai female from the diplomatic sectors and treated by Vaelia.

entries.name: Vorstag
entries.evidence: Introduced as an elite Redalious warrior and legend, treated by the medical Lord Kaelen.

entries.name: Elara
entries.evidence: Explicitly introduced by name as a high-priestess of the Unmatara clan.

entries.name: Theros
entries.evidence: Explicitly introduced as a legendary Varvadeil logician.

entries.name: Seraphine
entries.evidence: Explicitly introduced as a revered elder of the Mefuli rank whose existence spans millennia.

entries.name: Qy'lan
entries.evidence: Lady Qy'lan is a lower-ranking Varvadeil scholar used in a Causal-Calculus demonstration.

entries.name: Tyron
entries.evidence: Supreme Commander Tyron appears in historical archives defending the Outer Venshen Gates.

entries.name: Vael'thor
entries.evidence: Lord Vael'thor is identified as a senior Varvadeil researcher who initiates the first controlled Zeren-operation.

entries.name: Sylvane
entries.evidence: Elite Vanguard Sylvane is a female combatant in a detailed spar against Commander Varek.

entries.name: Xyris
entries.evidence: Sub-Commander Xyris participates in an ascension duel against a Vanguard Kaelar for Kafai Primus.

entries.name: Keena
entries.evidence: The source calls Keena an external entity, a cherished ally and friend of the Empire's closest confidants, who seeks connection to Rhayhara.

entries.name: Othrys
entries.evidence: The Veyndarion Clan designs Othrys, 'The Orthogonal Nullification', as a Sehexi-room adversary for Rhayhara.

entries.name: Null-Axiom
entries.evidence: A named Veyndarion conceptual adversary repeatedly manifested against Rhayhara across escalating trials.

entries.name: The Arithmetician
entries.evidence: The source explicitly identifies The Arithmetician as a high-ranking commander of Lay's autonomous forces.

entries.name: Eidos Swarm
entries.evidence: The Eidos Swarm is explicitly introduced as an entity/threat with paracognitive mirroring ability.

entries.name: Liora
entries.evidence: HGL page 68 explicitly introduces an Archfemale named Liora in a permanent-stagnation example.

entries.issue: A transmission identifies a Valerius as one of the original Kafai architects of the Z-ladder, but does not explicitly connect him to either Valerius Varvadeil or Valerius of the Omnivox lineage.
A detailed source uses Commander Varek in a spar against Sylvane. The current encyclopedia has Varek Unmatara, but the source excerpt does not restate the Unmatara identity.
A source uses Vanguard Kaelar in a Kafai-Primus ascension duel. Kaelar Omnivox exists separately in the encyclopedia; the duel passage does not explicitly establish they are the same person.
Two source passages use Grand Architect Kaelen. Existing pages already preserve multiple unresolved Kaelen identities; this usage must remain separate until an explicit link is found.
Multiple transmissions explicitly use 'Rhayhara Nayhatora' for the Supreme Empress. This is an alias/full-name candidate for the Rhayhara page, not evidence for a separate character.

entries.name: Kaelira / Vespera
entries.reason: The source says an alternate Rhayhara could be reborn as a distinct Arthitean 'perhaps named Kaelira or Vespera'; these are hypothetical example names, not established persistent identities.

entries.name: Michael / the Author
entries.reason: Source-person-in-text / real-world identity layer. Existing methodology does not create a fictional character page merely from transport or author references.

entries.name: Zubaida / Sovereign Chronicler
entries.reason: Source-person-in-text / correspondent-avatar boundary requires privacy-preserving separation; not automatically a fictional character page.
